items.text: Packers RB Josh Jacobs (finger) officially inactive for Wednesday night vs Rams; limited all week but not cleared post-surgery.
items.why: Fractured finger surgery; LaFleur expected unlikely; limited practices insufficient.
items.implication: Sit Jacobs; GB backfield to Lloyd/Johnson/Brooks.
items.opportunity: Increased carries/snaps for MarShawn Lloyd and committee

items.text: Chiefs officially ruled out RB Kenneth Walker III for Thursday night vs Bills due to groin injury; third straight miss. Rookie Emmett Johnson starts again.
items.why: Groin; DNP Wednesday after limited Tuesday; short week caution.
items.implication: Sit Walker; start handcuff/backup for volume.
items.opportunity: Full lead-back snaps/carries/targets to backup RB

items.text: 49ers QB Brock Purdy did not practice Wednesday with ankle injury from SNF vs Vikings; day-to-day per Shanahan.
items.why: Low ankle sprain suffered Q2 Sunday night.
items.implication: Monitor practice/status closely; potential sit or limited.
items.opportunity: If out, backup QB and checkdown/usage shifts to skill players

items.text: LOVE Bucky Irving this week vs Carolina. Since Week 5 only Gibbs and CMC average more PPG among RBs; elite matchup.
items.why: Elite recent PPG + soft CAR run defense.
items.opportunity: High snap/carry share in favorable matchup

items.text: Jaguars RB Bhayshul Tuten did not practice Wednesday due to foot/ankle injuries; injury resurfaces.
items.why: Foot/ankle; ETR noted resurfacing in recent loss.
items.implication: Questionable availability; monitor for role reduction.
items.opportunity: Potential snaps/carries to other JAC RBs if limited/out

items.text: Derrick Henry target share up to 12% and 4.5 rec/game with Brissett (from <6%/1.3); significantly raises PPR floor.
items.why: Two games with Brissett show increased involvement.
items.implication: LOVE floor; more reliable PPR RB.

items.text: D'Andre Swift snap/rush share drops with Monangai back (47% snaps, 39% rushes); Jaylen Warren only 51% rushes since Dowdle return, low targets—both mid/low RB2.
items.implication: Downgrade from prior RB1/fringe; cautious starts.

items.text: Puka Nacua and TE Terrance Ferguson out for the season (Rams); major WR/TE depth hit.
items.implication: Rams WR corps depleted; elevate remaining options ROS.
items.opportunity: Targets/routes to Adams (if back), Atwell, others; TE streamers

items.text: Packers WR Christian Watson questionable to return tonight (thigh) then returned to game.
items.implication: Usage may be monitored but available post-return.

items.text: Micah Parsons officially active for Packers vs Rams (knee); Zaire Franklin inactive.
items.implication: Boosts GB defense; limited fantasy skill impact.

items.text: Bo Nix on HATE list this week; expecting heavy Jonah Coleman vs PIT and insufficient Nix rushing; outside top 20.
items.why: Coleman workload surge without Harvey; low Nix rush upside.

items.text: On Travis Etienne: could see disappointing snaps/routes down stretch but reasonably high carry count; favorable ARZ/ATL Weeks 16/17.
items.why: Citing Graziano; volume mix shift possible.
items.implication: Floor via carries; monitor route share; playoff schedule boost.
items.opportunity: Carry volume floor despite potential snap/route drop

items.text: DeVonta Smith 57% target share in Week 11; averages 36% on season, 50% end-zone targets; role elite despite injuries.
items.why: Massive target dominance in limited sample.
items.implication: Must-start WR when healthy; Ride-or-Die validation.

items.text: Ladd McConkey season-high 38% target share on return (17.5 PPG when 20%+); Trey McBride 39% targets last 2 but 3 aDOT/low YPR—volume TE but not elite.
items.why: McConkey healthy share rebound; McBride volume vs efficiency.
items.implication: Start McConkey if healthy; McBride safe but capped ceiling.
